calculator_engine: function stepUpSip(P,annualRate,years,stepUp){let fv=0;let invested=0;const r=annualRate/100/12;for(let y=1;y<=years;y++){const monthly=P*Math.pow(1+stepUp/100,y-1);const n=(years-y+1)*12;fv+=monthly*(Math.pow(1+r,n)-1)/r*(1+r);invested+=monthly*12;}return{invested,returns:fv-invested,maturity:fv};}
